क + द् (the old nom. acc. sing. n. of किम्; cf. Lat. quod; O.H.G. huaz; A.S. hvät).
 1. With following चिद् कच्चिद् कच् चिद्, particle of interrogation, [] Perhaps,
. As former part of compound nouns, Bad, e. g. कद्-अन्न, n. Bad food, Bhāg.

.
 कद्-अपत्य, adj. Having a bad offspring, 4, 13, 43.
 कद्-इन्द्रिय, n. pl. The paltry organs of sense, 8, 3, 28.
 3. Combined with vb. दा, To blame, 7, 5, 28; with अर्थ्, q.v.

कद्, or † कन्द् कन्द्, or † क्रन्द् क्रन्द्, or † क्लन्द् क्लन्द्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. † To be confused.
 2. † To confound.
 3. To kill; चकाद,

कदम्ब,
 I. m. A tree, Nauclea cadamba (its flower, when fullblown, is covered with projecting anthers),

कादम्ब,
 I. m. A kind of goose,

.
 II. i. e. कदम्ब + अ, n. The flower of the Nauclea cadamba, Roxb.,

.
 --Cf. perhaps, Lat. columba; κόλυμβος; O.H.G. tûba; A.S. dûua.
कदम्ब + क, n. Plenty, Śāk. d. 39.
कदर्थन. i. e. कद्-अर्थ् + अन, n. and f. ना, Tormenting,

कदल,
 I. m. and f. ली, The plaintain tree, Musa sapientum,

.
 II. f. ली, A kind of deer,
कदलिका, i. e. कदली + क, f. The plaintain tree,
क + दा (see किम्), adv. At what time,

. With following चन,
 1. Once, some time; preceded by न, Never,
. Perhaps, [] Pañc. 22, 10. With following चिद्, Once,
. Followed by अपि, and preceded by न, Never,
कद्रू, f. The wife of Kaśyapa and mother of the serpent race,

कादम्बरी (for कादम्ब-वारि), f.
 1. The rain-water which collects in the hollow of the tree Nauclea cadamba when the flowers are in perfection, and which is supposed to be impregnated with their honey,

. A spirituous liquor, Śāk. 76, 6 (Prākṛ.).
 3. A proper name, Sāh.
